verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents loading from other databases, including a PostgreSQL/MySQL guide, and from object storage, with S3 setup docs covering secrets and direct S3/GCS/Azure queries. It also documents dbt integration via dbt-duckdb, which covers the transformation side of ELT. However, nothing in the evidence shows SaaS-app connectors or partner ingestion tools, and scheduled Python Flights are a build-your-own path rather than a connector. Missing for 10: SaaS application connectors, a documented partner ETL/ELT ingestion catalog, independent corroboration of connector setup.
